name: Baka wa Shinanakya Naoranai!
original_name: バカは死ななきゃ治らないっ！
source:
This is the debut work for doujin circle integral. Kazuhiko was run over by a truck on his first day of school. However, when he arrived in heaven, God told him that it’d be a problem if he was dead, and sent him back to Earth. He didn’t understand what happened, but he went to his classroom and found that he had to repeat the year. His osananajimi Kanade became his senpai, and a Russian serial killer Elena transferred into his class.

“Whoops, I added strychnine instead of salt >_<”
“Idiots can’t be cured unless they die!”

Is there a cure for possibly the most stupid person in the world? What will his destiny be after achieving immortality? Even God doesn’t know!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/08/01/august-2014-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是同人圈积分的出道作品。和彦开学第一天就被卡车碾过。然而，当他到达天堂时，上帝告诉他，如果他死了就有问题，并把他送回了地球。他不明白发生了什么事，但他回到教室，发现自己必须留级。他的长官奏成为了他的学长，俄罗斯连环杀手埃琳娜转入了他的班级。

“哎呀，我加了士的宁而不是盐>_<”
“白痴不死就无法治愈！”

对于可能是世界上最愚蠢的人来说，有治疗方法吗？成仙之后他的命运又会如何呢？连神都不知道！

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/08/01/august-2014-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
